meaning: deceitful, treacherous, deception, lie, deceptive, disappointing

renderings.kjv: wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar

elsewhere.note: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?
Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
